verdict.rationale: IP India's portal collects and publishes applicant filings, so whether user data can be excluded from AI training is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of online service. The evidence pack covers only e-filing, search, status tracking, journals and fees. Nothing mentions AI training, data-use policies or any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
